profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at John Deere
profile.summary: Designing, building, and operating production AI agent systems for enterprise at scale

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
JDF — John Deere Financial — Advanced Engineering Team

- Founded and architected JDF Atlas Agent — a production AI deep research platform (LangGraph, FastAPI, Next.js) with 140+ enterprise tool/skills integrations such as SNOW, Databricks, Confluence, SharePoints, NewRelic, JIRA, GitHub and so on including MCP-based tools, supporting organizational strategic and tactical decision-making
- Built multi-agent (20+) AI systems including a structured debate framework with domain/persona-driven agents, knowledge graph modeling and integration (Stardog/RDF), beads - todo, real-time voice AI (OpenAI Realtime API), PII detection/redaction, LLM as Judge and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication
- Delivered the Credit Underwriting Platform — a React/TypeScript serverless application on AWS for credit analysis with WAF security, document management (FileNet/DDS), AI-powered financial spreading (Agentic Workflow), and CDN performance optimization
- Engineered CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes deployments, including automated evaluation suites across tools
- Implemented enterprise security across both platforms: Multi-auth provider, RBAC, WAF, sensitivity label enforcement, CSP headers, and OWASP-aligned hardening

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Global IT - I&O Space - Web Platform / Cloud Native Team

- CaaS Bot - AI-Powered Developer Experience Platform: Engineered comprehensive multi-channel caas ecosystem with web portal (LangChain), VSCode/IDE integration (MCP tools), GitHub Actions, CLI, and Teams integration, serving 100+ engineering teams with intelligent Kubernetes operations.
- AI-Powered Developer Assistant with RAG & Evaluation: Implemented extensive RAG knowledge bases with continuous evaluation frameworks ensuring contextual accuracy for platform operations.
- Automated Code Review - Async AI Agent: Built intelligent code review system analyzing PRs for security, quality, performance, and compliance issues with severity-based classification and actionable remediation steps.
- GitOps - Automated PR: Created intelligent PR generation converting natural language issues into production-ready PRs, reducing manual effort by 80% and saving 1000+ hours across fleet-wide repository management.
- Automated Remediation Pipeline: Built end-to-end workflow integrating GitHub Actions and SNOW for automatic failure analysis, issue creation, and AI-driven PR generation within minutes.
- Enterprise Tool Ecosystem & Developer Experience: Integrated 15+ specialized tools with CLI commands (caas ask, ai) enabling natural language Kubernetes queries, interactive AI REPL, and web portal.
- Incident Response & Intelligent Troubleshooting: Reduced MTTR through automated ServiceNow integration, AI-powered diagnostics, and intelligent remediation across multi-cluster environments.
- Cloud Infrastructure Modernization: Orchestrated comprehensive upgrades across AWS EKS, EKSA, and RKE2 with zero-downtime, implementing best practices for security and scalability.
- Developed multi-stack Backstage templates adopted by 400+ apps, saving 60+ hrs/app and delivering full-stack solutions in minutes.
- Managed and optimized 50k+ pods across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments ensuring high availability and scalability.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Global IT - I&O Space - Software Supply Chain Team

- Designed and build various tools based of GitHub API and GitHub Apps to drive the audit, risk and compliance adoption across the company.
- Delivered Software Bill of Materials for all kind of package manifests-based GitHub Repos across the company to fulfill the board of directors’ goal.
- Developed Scorecard, Billing, Security, Lighthouse, DAST and so on Backstage Plugins to drive security, compliance with dev portal.
- Collaborated in JFrog Artifactory to serve 13+ registries and various package manager-based code migration tools for easy migration across the company.
- Optimized caching mechanisms for artifacts, resulting in significant cost savings and improved performance of the Artifactory service.
- Experimented with signed build with SBOM attestation and audit trail to secure software build and get compliant at SLSA 3+ level.
- Hacked on GitHub Action Runner on on-prem K8s & EKS to save $100k+ cost per year in AWS EC2 ephemeral runners’ overhead
- Driving exploit research and documenting mitigations for wider audience
- Establishing the eBPF based runtime security agent pipeline to monitor the Github Action Runners to detect security incidents as pilot.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Global IT - I&O Space - Site Reliability Engineering Team

- Being part of Global IT, supported PDM, ISG, JDF, OM, GSEC and so on in SRE engagements to address their problems
- Develop and manage scalable, secure and stable systems
- Collaborating with DevOps, SecOps, Architecture, Operation & Application teams on providing best practices and standards in playbook format
- Lead log aggregation strategy for PDM products and designed various logging patterns such as SAP Logging, OnPrem Logging, Container Logging, Lambda Layer Logging.
- Participated in hackathon with the idea around Okta Self Service based automation to reduce support overhead and reduced okta application creation process from days to minutes.
- Designed product health dashboards, SLI monitors & alerts around API gateway to help IE team and API consumers in supporting their API journey.
- Addressed Adobe AEM related reliability and performance concern with DE, OM teams, that lead the successful game day events in dealership.
- Delivered Tech Talks on the below topics in ISG-JDF AWS Conferences
     - How to build portable, reliable and efficient distributed microservices - 2022 
        (DAPR,Envoy, Open Policy Agent, K8s, Demo)
    - Fix your Applications to its Core !–2022 (eBPF, Flamegraph, Heatmap, Demo) 
    - Observability – 2021 (Logging, Metrics, Tracing, Monitoring, Alerting)
    - Advance Docker Security – 2021 (Seccomp, AppArmor, Tracee, Falco...)

positions.title: Staff Developer
positions.description:
Space - Intelligent Solutions Group - Data Platform - Master Data - SOUP Team

- Converted legacy monolith Axiom Platform to Docker and updated to AWS ECS with best practices. Additionally, optimized application to handle large amount of API requests (in billions) with less resources and improved application performance, stability & overall development experience.
- Delivered various side cars (Logging, OAuth Proxy, Mongos, Xray, Envoy) in the Platform and Node Web Apps to establish application isolation best practices. Additionally, it provided next generation advantages of higher productivity, sustainability and scalability.
- Supported overall organizations - customer connections goal to provide visibility on third-party data sharing activities and features
- Fixing critical security vulnerabilities and enhancing security to protect company’s branding
- Collaborating in complex 15+ data domains deletion compliance process and implementation
- Improved product ingestion service architecture and achieved the SLO with the heaviest load
- Migrated and improved several developer enablement applications in security, compliance, performance, budget and features  
- Converted Axiom Platform (a legacy monolith) to Docker and updated AWS ECS with best practices to improve performance and stability. Additionally, optimized it to handle better load and resources in heavy stress conditions (million requests per minute)
- Designed and developed nightly ETL reports to support overall organizations compliance goals 
- One of the core members of Purple Team Cyber Security community and driving purple activities to enhance Red Team and Blue Team capabilities

positions.title: Staff Developer
positions.description:
Space - Intelligent Solutions Group - Digital - Setup, Plan & Monitor Space

Products - AutoPath™, Setup Builder, Land Manager, Guidance Line Converter,
Persistent Header, Team Manager, Products Manager, FieldConnect

- Supported more than 5 teams on their product development and delivery
- Participated and collaborated on multiple teams’ sprint planning, backlog grooming, runway, pairing, firefighter, mobs, retro activity and so on.
- Nurtured chaos engineering and site reliability engineering practices in teams by doing the “fire drills”
- Collaborating with DevOps Guild & Teams on providing Golden Standards in "Application Architecture Playbook" to provide a placeholder for developer on doing their own decisions
- Documented and collaborated on “Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) Playbook” (including Site reliability engineering (SRE) practices) and “Sustainability Playbooks” to support organizational awareness
- Actively kept technology backlogs for adoption and trial to keep up teams with technology trends
- Delivered Tech Talks on below topics in ISG-JDF AWS Conferences
    - Application Architecture Playbook 2020
    - Service Mesh 2020
    - Authentication Tips and Tricks Topic 2019
    - AWS Cloud Q&A - Panelist 2019
- Restored legacy application to AWS in urgency and saved a large deal with US Sugar in 2019
- Represented John Deere into Prepare.ai 2020 as a virtual booth representative and demoed operation center applications
- Represented John Deere into GOTO Chicago 2020 Conference as a speaker and given talks on, John Deere Operation Center Development Journey and EcoSystem 
& John Deere Operation Center Hands On Lab – Developer API
- Engaged and developed with product teams, SecOps and DevOps on improving the autonomy, risk analysis and security best practices

positions.title: Staff Developer
positions.description:
Space - ISG Digital Analyze Space
Products - Field Analyzer, Field Analyzer Beta, Agronomic Reports, Agronomic API, IMET Data Products, Export Agronomic Data

- Delivering a new cloud platform solutions in setup, plan and analyze based Agronomic Products  as a staff engineer of organization
- Designing new API specification & documentation
- Driving proof of concepts & benchmarks on the technology stack selection along with architects review
- Developing and driving Test Driven Development(TDD) in Java-Spring, Scala & NodeJS
- Developing full stack automation pipeline in AWS to deliver middleware solutions
- Communicating and collaborating knowledge with various teams on product development
- Assist QA to deliver integration tests on newer platform
- Researching in Android Things to deliver IoT solution and best practices
- Providing insight and solutions to stakeholders on multiple domains based system level issues
- Fixing defects in Java, .NET, Scala & NodeJS based applications

- Delivered mobile strategy around Enterprise Github, Jenkins-CI, Google Cloud & AWS Infrastructure
- Administrating and Reviewing Mobile related tools and library
- Designing, Developing and Documenting iOS & Android MobileSDK for John Deere Applications
- Documenting and Validating process flows to provide better quality and security for Mobile Applications
- Assisted in Agriculture, Construction & Forestry industries based mobile eco-system for seamless experience
- Designing Automation and Deployment strategies to meet various team expectations with consistency workflow
- Developing proof of concept to achieve solution of existing issues
- Solved various mobile and enterprise infrastructure related complex problem 
- Assisted in delivering various analytics reports and results
- Assisted in various phase of application's legal approval and compliance
- Design & Develop security model to help maintain user's privacy in Mobile Apps & Infrastructure
- Streamlining all process to achieve end-product
- Researched and coded for Flatbuffer & Protobuf type advance technology use cases

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
AT&T - WebRTC Developer

- Audio/Video Calling Functionality with Chrome and Firefox Browsers
- Hold/Resume, Transfer & Move Call functionality implementation

- Devised and implemented strategies to work around CORS, Environment and Browsers issues
- Provided guidance and support to various development and test team on how to resolve issues on all levels
